context: Two managers review a rules update during a coffee break
purpose: Teach: 判明/改定/答申/定年/発足/定める/出力/分割

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 昨日の会議で就業規則の改定案が出たけど、もう目を通した？
lines.en: The revised work rules proposal came out at yesterday's meeting — have you looked through it yet?
lines.style: Casual workplace tone with a rising, inquisitive ending.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ざっと読んだよ。委員会の答申に沿って、定年が六十五歳に引き上げられるらしいね。
lines.en: I gave it a quick read. Following the committee's recommendation, retirement age is apparently being raised to sixty-five.
lines.style: Measured, slightly reserved manager voice with a thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうそう。来月発足する新しい人事委員会が、具体的な運用ルールを定めるって書いてあった。
lines.en: Right. It said the new HR committee launching next month will set the specific operational rules.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning-forward conversational pace with mild enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 退職金も三回に分けて支給する分割払いになるみたいで、ちょっと驚いたよ。
lines.en: Retirement payouts are apparently shifting to installment payments in three rounds too, which surprised me a bit.
lines.style: Mildly concerned, thinking aloud over coffee.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うちのチームで試算してみたら、若手にはむしろ有利だって出力結果が出たよ。
lines.en: When our team ran the numbers, the output actually showed it favors younger employees.
lines.style: Informative and slightly reassuring, breaking down the data casually.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど。新しい支給額の根拠もそれで判明したわけか。
lines.en: I see. So that's how the basis for the new payout amounts became clear.
lines.style: Reflective realization, processing the new information aloud.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん。詳しい数字は後で共有フォルダに上げとくね。
lines.en: Yeah. I'll upload the detailed numbers to the shared folder later.
lines.style: Brief, cooperative offer to follow up after the break.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かる。じゃあ午後、部下にも周知しておくよ。コーヒーお代わり頼む？
lines.en: Thanks. Then I'll brief my team in the afternoon. Want another coffee refill?
lines.style: Warm collegial wrap-up, closing the work topic kindly.
